press_references.value: Ex-Twitter CEO Parag Agrawal Launches Parallel: The AI Startup Set to Redefine Online Research Forever

product_launches.description: Parallel Web Systems launched its AI-powered cloud platform, Parallel, which enables AI systems to conduct real-time online research and outperform leading AI models in research tasks.

overview_description.description: Parallel develops web-based infrastructure and APIs designed to enable artificial intelligence systems to access, process, and act on information from the open web. Its platform provides tools such as search, extraction, task execution, and monitoring APIs that allow AI agents to perform complex, multi-step research and data retrieval workflows. The company focuses on building systems that combine data retrieval, computation, and reasoning into unified outputs, emphasizing verifiable results and traceable sources. Its technology supports use cases such as structured data generation, continuous web monitoring, and automated dataset enrichment using real-time web data. Overall, Parallel Web Systems is oriented toward creating infrastructure that enables AI agents to interact with the web programmatically rather than through traditional human browsing patterns.

about_short_description.short_description: Parallel develops a suite of agents and tool APIs for building AI that accesses and utilizes the open web.

product.name: Parallel Search API
product.description: An API that provides web search results and context for AI agents, including source evidence and provenance for retrieved information.

product.name: Parallel Task API
product.description: An API for running multi-step web research tasks and building agents that gather, analyze, and synthesize information from the open web.

product.name: Parallel Monitor API
product.description: An API for continuously monitoring web sources and detecting changes or events that match defined criteria.

product.name: Parallel FindAll API
product.description: An API for discovering entities or pages on the web that match natural-language criteria and returning the results as structured data.

product.name: Parallel Extract API
product.description: An API for extracting specified information from web pages and returning it in structured, application-ready formats.

product.name: Parallel Chat API
product.description: An API for building conversational AI experiences that use web research and evidence-backed information during interactions.
